bib.title: Query2doc: Query Expansion with Large Language Models
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 2023 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP), pages 9414-9423

question: Can few-shot prompted LLM-generated pseudo-documents expand short queries to improve sparse and dense retrieval without fine-tuning the LLM?
hypothesis: LLMs memorize web-scale knowledge, so their generated pseudo-documents contain relevant terms that disambiguate the query and bridge the lexical gap.
contributions: query2doc: query expansion by few-shot prompting LLMs for pseudo-documents, concatenated with the query
Gains for BM25 (3% to 15%) without fine-tuning and for dense retrievers in-domain and out-of-domain
Release of all text-davinci-003 generations for MS-MARCO

method.summary: Prompt an LLM with an instruction and 4 random MS-MARCO (query, passage) pairs to write a passage for the query, then form q+ by repeating the query 5 times plus the passage (BM25) or query [SEP] passage (dense). Dense retrievers are retrained with expanded queries (DPR with contrastive loss; SimLM/E5 with KL distillation plus contrastive loss).
method.task: ad-hoc passage retrieval with query expansion

datasets.name: MS-MARCO passage ranking
datasets.split: train for dense retrievers and few-shot examples; dev for eval
datasets.preprocessing: pseudo-documents generated for training queries too (most of the ~550k API calls)

datasets.name: BEIR: DBpedia, NFCorpus, Scifact, Trec-Covid, Touche2020

other.pooling: [CLS] for SimLM, mean pooling for E5

training.objective: contrastive loss with BM25 hard negatives (DPR); KL(p_ce, p_stu) + alpha * contrastive (distillation)
training.compute: training and evaluation of a dense retriever under 10 hours

other.fig2_ablation: fine-tune 40 epochs or 18k steps, whichever first
other.teacher: cross-encoder scores released by SimLM authors

inference.top_p: inferred: Appendix C mentions top-p sampling but gives no value
inference.samples: 1 pseudo-document per query; 3 random runs for Table 10 variance
inference.prompting: instruction + k=4 random MS-MARCO train pairs, resampled per API call
inference.retrieval: BM25 and RM3 via Pyserini defaults; top 100 for latency

other.gpt4_system_message: You are asked to write a passage that answers the given query. Do not ask the user for further clarification.

eval.protocol: Main results single run; 3-run mean/std for sparse retrieval in Table 10; no significance test stated

prompts.where: Fig 1 / Table 11 (full text with 4 examples, p10)
